answer_text:
For a five-person team you want something that's quick to set up, keeps the pipeline visible and doesn't need an admin. These are the strongest options right now: [1]

- **Tallyfox**: Simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites. [2]
- **Pipewell**: Pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages. [3]
- **Northwind CRM Essentials**: The safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace. [4]

In short, trial Tallyfox and Pipewell side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
